info.name: Grubhub Deliveries Delivery Status Menu Schedule Overrides API

params.name: merchant_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the merchant on Grubhub.

items.docs: Creates or updates menu schedule overrides for a merchant. Schedule overrides allow temporary changes to menu availability, such as making certain items unavailable during specific time periods.

info.name: Grubhub Get Menu Schedule Override Job Status

params.name: merchant_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the merchant on Grubhub.

params.name: job_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the ingestion or override job.

items.docs: Returns the status of a menu schedule override job for a merchant.
